request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Boglace Frog".

Creative brief
Name: Boglace Frog
Collection: Mirebound Court. Swamp creatures serving a drowned marsh court, marked by reeds, lilies, mud, spores, leeches, and deceptive water formations.
Core concept: A hopping pattern caster that stitches projectile lines between its landing points.
Body and silhouette: Round frog with long rear legs, raised eyes, and lace-like pondweed hanging from its limbs.
Signature features: Lily-pad collar, threadlike algae, and a glowing throat sac.
Palette and materials: Marsh green, muddy brown, pale lavender, and soft yellow-green.
Movement personality: Springy, cautious, and rhythmically precise.
Attack concept: Performs three marked hops, then fires slow water beads along the triangular path connecting those landing points.
Directional details: A small lily flower grows above the right eye.
Avoid: Cute cartoon frog, realistic wet skin, water lines too thin to read.
